summary.sub: 两条agent产品、一条资本动向，均用一手原文加独立媒体核对。

items.t: Claude Meetings测试版上线Team和Enterprise，先支持Google Meet，只存转写不存音频
Perplexity的长期任务agent Teammates进入Mac应用，仅限Max订阅
Norwest推出第18期基金40亿美元，史上最大，AI是重点方向

title.text: Claude能进视频会议了，以可见参会者身份

oneline.text: Team和Enterprise测试版，先支持Google Meet，测试期笔记和转写免费。

bullets.v: Anthropic推出Claude Meetings测试版，Claude作为可见参会者加入通话，边听边起草计划。
只存转写、摘要和屏幕描述，不存音频；有外部客人时默认不进会。
开会前先确认所有人同意被转写；ZDR、HIPAA配置的组织测试期用不了。

sourceEvidence.claim: Claude以可见参会者加入视频会议
sourceEvidence.quote: Claude can now join your video calls as a visible participant
Claude Meetings is starting to roll out in beta on Team and Enterprise plans.
Support is currently available for Google Meet, with other platforms coming soon.
It saves a transcript, summary, and screen descriptions, not audio.
During the beta, Claude's notes and transcripts are free on Team and Enterprise plans.
As participants talk, it can draft the plan being discussed
It won't join calls with external guests unless authorized by an admin

oneline.text: 一组负责长期任务的AI agent，此前只有网页版和iOS，仍限Max订阅。

bullets.v: 11月13日9to5Mac报道，Teammates已在Perplexity Mac应用上线，面向Max订阅用户。
每个teammate在独立环境运行，浏览器会话互相隔离，保存的凭据加密填写。
Max价格官方页没写；推广期Max含免费Teammates用量，到期后的计费方式还不清楚。

sourceEvidence.quote: Teammates are a team of AI agents that own ongoing work.
For a promotional period, every Max plan will include free usage for Perplexity teammates.
Each teammate runs in a separate environment, with browser sessions separate from other teammates.
Perplexity Teammates were previously limited to iOS and the web.
Teammates are now available in the Perplexity Mac app for Max subscribers.

oneline.text: 第18期、史上最大，覆盖早期到成长期，科技、医疗、消费三条线。

bullets.v: 11月12日Norwest宣布第18期基金40亿美元，管理资本总额到180亿美元。
TechCrunch点名的AI方向：physical AI、语音AI、agent安全，没公布AI占比。
agent测试、语音、医疗AI继续是热门赛道，求职选公司可参考资金流向。

sourceEvidence.quote: Today, we’re announcing Norwest 18, a $4 billion fund and the largest in our firm’s history
bringing our total capital under management to $18 billion
spanning venture and growth equity investments across three core sectors: technology, healthcare, and consumer.
But the big story here is AI, and Norwest’s plans to expand its investment in this area.
physical AI, voice AI, agentic cybersecurity, and aerospace.

mp.title: Claude能进视频会议了，Perplexity Teammates上Mac，Norwest募40亿美元押AI
